entities.name: Saryth
entities.description: Human warlock and hedgewitch from Kessig who founded her own coven devoted to a forgotten snake god, and controlled Sinnia through a mask.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: Leader of the Dawnhart Coven who clashed with Saryth.

entities.name: Dawnhart Coven
entities.description: Coven that reformed under Katilda and revered Ghrin-Danu.

entities.name: Ghrin-Danu
entities.description: God worshipped by the Dawnhart Coven.

entities.name: Sinnia
entities.description: Leinore's younger sister, controlled by Saryth through a mask.

entities.name: Leinore
entities.description: Sinnia's elder sister who saved her with Katilda.

entities.name: Coiled One
entities.description: Massive snake-like god Saryth intended to summon.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane Saryth sought to save from darkness.

events.summary: Saryth, believing Ghrin-Danu's power insufficient, leaves or is expelled from the coven and founds her own for a forgotten snake god.
events.quote: Saryth decided to found her coven, one dedicated to a forgotten snake god of venom and vengeance.

events.summary: Saryth controls Sinnia through a mask to attract people to sacrifice in the forest.
Leinore and Katilda save Sinnia and interrupt the ritual; Saryth falls into a hole made by the ritual to her supposed death.
events.quote: Saryth fell into a hole that was made by the ritual, to her supposed death.

relations.note: They were at odds and fought.
relations.quote: the leader Katilda was at odds with the young acolyte Saryth
